newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan government sacks state news agency chief.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan government sacks state news agency chief.

text.p: Pakistan's caretaker government said on Thursday it had sacked the head of the state news agency Associated Press of Pakistan (APP), accused by journalist unions of illegal sackings and staff victimisation.

The APP quoted Information Minister Irshad Ahmad Haqqasi as telling reporters in the Punjab province capital of Lahore that the agency's director-general Azhar Suhail had been removed and a replacement would be named within the next two days.

Journalists held nationwide protests against the sackings by Suhail, an Urdu-language newspaper columnist, after ousted prime minister Benazir Bhutto's government gave him the job last year in place of veteran journalist Aslam Sheikh.
